routines.name: mmio_transition_wait
routines.scope: MMIO polling transition compared over 25 deterministic sequences, including values with only bits outside the retail mask set.

routines.name: mmio_idle_flag_store
routines.scope: Output memory comparison for all low-byte MMIO values, fixed edge values and 64 deterministic words, with cached and uncached RAM aliases.

limitations: MMIO is injected through a host read adapter; electrical timing, asynchronous register changes outside supplied sequences, and SH-4 bus faults are not modeled.
